# Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Transformers: Architecture, Training, and Deployment

## 1. Core Architecture

A Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) layer replaces the standard feed-forward network (FFN) in a Transformer block with a **gated mixture of multiple FFN sub-networks**, called *experts*. Each expert is independently trained, and a **gating network** (router) determines which experts process each input token.

### Structural Components

```
Input Token Embedding
        │
        ▼
┌─────────────────┐
│  Router (Gating) │  ← Lightweight network (typically linear layer)
│  Produces scores │     for each expert
└─────────────────┘
        │
        ▼
   Top-K Routing      ← Selects K experts per token
        │
        ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Expert 1   Expert 2   ...   Expert N   │  ← Parallel FFNs
│  FFN₁(x)   FFN₂(x)        FFNₙ(x)      │
└──────────────────────────────────────────┘
        │
        ▼
   Weighted Sum        ← Combine outputs using router weights
        │
        ▼
   Residual + LayerNorm → Output
```
